subject.title: fix: ClawHub search passes unbounded limit to the API

question: Should `openclaw skills search --limit` preserve its current ability to request more than 100 results, or gain a new explicit maximum of 100?
rationale: The Gateway already has a separate 100-result contract, but the native CLI accepts larger values and the live service honors them; silently narrowing that public behavior requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve CLI range
options.body: Remove the lifecycle-wide maximum, retain the Gateway schema maximum, and validate each entry point according to its existing contract.

options.title: Adopt explicit CLI maximum
options.body: Reject values above 100 at CLI parsing, document the new contract, and add live fresh-install and upgrade-behavior proof.

options.title: Defer the bound
options.body: Close or pause the proposal if no measured live harm warrants changing the current CLI contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve CLI range
recommendation.body: Remove the lifecycle-wide maximum, retain the Gateway schema maximum, and validate each entry point according to its existing contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the native ClawHub skill-search CLI and is best positioned to decide its public input contract.
